`class ReorderableFlexNode`<br/>
**Extends:** [`FlexNode`](/reference/layout/flexnode/)<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.ui.node.impl.layout` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [ReorderableFlexNode.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/ui/node/impl/layout/ReorderableFlexNode.java)

A flex column or row whose children the user reorders by dragging them.

![A vertical list of four rows, the second one grey; the pointer drags the grey row to the bottom, the other rows slide up, then it drags the row back to second place](/captures/catalog-nodes-reorderableflexnode.webp)

## Description

A left press on a child starts the drag; the other children slide away, and a scrolling parent scrolls when the child nears its edge.
When the button is released, the child slides into its new place and the children take the new order.
Pinned children keep their place.

Adds a listener that runs when a drag starts.

<a id="ReorderableFlexNode-event-onReorder"></a>

### onReorder

`this onReorder(EventListener<NodeReorderEvent.Post<T>> listener)` <span class="joid-qualifier">fluent</span>

Adds a listener that runs each time the dragged child takes another place.

<a id="ReorderableFlexNode-event-onReorderEnd"></a>

### onReorderEnd

`this onReorderEnd(EventListener<NodeReorderEvent.Post<T>> listener)` <span class="joid-qualifier">fluent</span>

Adds a listener that runs when the dragged child has settled, with its first and its last place.

---

<small>`fluent` returns the instance, typed for chaining · `factory` creates an instance · `signal` also accepts a value that follows signals, as a signal, an expression or a lambda ([When does JOID compute this value again?](/use/learn/interactivity/signals/#ask-when-does-joid-compute-this-value-again)) · `hook` called by JOID, override it · `abstract` you implement it · `default` interface method with a body · `static` called on the class · `protected` visible to subclasses</small>
